subject.title: feat: add hosted feed envelope verifier

question: Should OpenClaw accept this DSSE-based verifier primitive as the trust-contract foundation for the signed hosted feed stack now?
rationale: The patch looks correct for the isolated verifier, but it creates the security contract downstream signed-feed enforcement will consume, so maintainer intent is required before landing.

options.title: Land verifier foundation
options.body: Accept this narrow primitive now and keep user-facing signed-feed enforcement in the staged follow-up PRs.

options.title: Pause for contract changes
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want different envelope fields, key-id behavior, threshold semantics, or RFC wording before downstream work depends on it.

recommendation.title: Land verifier foundation
recommendation.body: Accept this narrow primitive now and keep user-facing signed-feed enforcement in the staged follow-up PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the assigned reviewer and already reviewed the verifier contract and CI repair path.
